title: Vintage Le Creuset Stoneware French Press / Coffee Pot – Mist Grey
description:
Elegant vintage Le Creuset stoneware French press in a beautiful soft mist grey shade with a cream interior. A timeless and minimalist piece, perfect for coffee lovers and collectors of vintage Le Creuset stoneware.
This model features the original stainless steel plunger and filter system, with the classic Le Creuset embossed lid and base markings. Its tall and refined silhouette makes it both practical and decorative in a kitchen or coffee corner.
The piece is in very good vintage condition with light signs of age and use consistent with vintage kitchenware. The glaze remains glossy and presents beautifully overall. Please examine all photos carefully as they form part of the description.
Approximate dimensions:
Height: around 20 cm
Opening diameter: around 10 cm
A charming and increasingly sought-after vintage Le Creuset piece, ideal for everyday use or as part of a French stoneware collection.
